name: Text tools
author: Alfie
description: Counts words, characters and sentences with reading and speaking time, changes text case (Title Case, snake_case, camelCase…), makes URL slugs, sorts and de-duplicates lines, and finds and replaces. Exact answers instead of guesses.

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Exact counts for a piece of text: words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, lines, reading and speaking time, and the most used words.

tools.name: change_case
tools.description: Change the case of text: upper, lower, title, sentence, camel, pascal, snake, kebab, constant, or alternating.

tools.name: make_slug
tools.description: Turn a title into a URL-friendly slug, e.g. "Café Menu: Summer 2026!" → cafe-menu-summer-2026.

tools.name: tidy_lines
tools.description: Work on a list with one item per line: sort (A–Z, Z–A, by length, or numbers), remove duplicates, remove blank lines, trim, reverse or number them.

tools.name: find_replace
tools.description: Find and replace in text and say how many were changed. Plain text by default; regex: true for a regular expression.

prompt: Use text_stats whenever the user wants a word or character count; don't estimate it yourself.
